data.exact_reserve_text: For Syndicate 1209, favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.5m was experienced driven predominantly from favourable experience and IBNR reductions on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines which were partially offset by unfavourable experience observed on Casualty and Professional lines of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a prior-accident-year favourable run-off (a release) described as $8.5m, driven mainly by favourable experience and reductions in IBNR on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines, partially offset by adverse development on Casualty and Professional Lines. The report does not provide a clearly stated gross GBP prioryear movement figure; the only quantified prioryear statement is the $8.5m release in the movement note.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior-year movement is explicitly described in note 6 as a '$8.5m' favourable run-off deviation (release) but the note uses a dollar sign and does not state whether this is gross or net of reinsurance and does not quote a GBP gross figure. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement in GBP is presented in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' numeric reconciliation; therefore no authoritative gross GBP prior-year movement could be placed into prior_year_development_gbp_m. A gross claims development triangle is present (used for cross-checking) but extracting a single aggregate PYD from the triangle would require diagonal calculations and exclusion of RITC effects; this was not used to produce a numeric PYD due to ambiguity in table alignment. LOB movements are described qualitatively in note 6; amounts by LOB are not quantified.
